title: A rule-set pack says in its first line that its lines are the rules and it has no coverage verdict
goal: The first line of python3 _tools/rag.py pack --root _self --set NAME says the set prints each tested rule question with its answering line and gives no coverage verdict, so a worker does not read a missing verdict as coverage none. SP-yyjwfjtc close: the ST-vaicbwt7 worker reported --set kb-worker as coverage: none and worked from the brief alone, while the set printed its 13 tested questions with their lines.
